After achieving our first gross margin positive year in 2025, it was time to focus on growth again. The senior leadership team set a goal of $100M of gross-margin-positive revenue in 2026, then built a financial plan around that goal.

We beat revenue in Q1 — driven by Fort Bliss ramping faster than expected and some R&D contract milestone acceleration — and are officially raising our FY 2026 revenue guidance to $103–109M.

02
Objective Two Titan · ICON Tech
LAUNCHED · MARCH 11, 2026

A new platform.
Not just a new printer.

On March 11 we hosted 120+ builders and developers at our first annual Converge conference, officially launching Titan and our technology business — ICON Tech.

FIG. 01 · TITAN · ICON HQ · TWILIGHT TESTING
Three Titans now in final calibration ahead of the first for-revenue prints this summer.
Reservations · Builders
32
Customers committed at launch
Reservations · Units
61
1.9 Titans per customer · avg.
Titan list price
$899k
First deliveries · Mar / Apr 2027

Titan is a step-function improvement over our legacy Vulcan system: lower costs, faster speeds, and the ability to print two-story structures. With a list price of $899k, Titan gives small-to-medium-sized builders cost savings, time savings, and a higher-performance, differentiated product, allowing them to compete with the largest builders.

From our perspective, Titan brings us a high-margin, SaaS-like recurring revenue business model, with stacking cohorts of Titan owners continuing to purchase ICON's proprietary materials, software, and architecture as they build.

Thirty-two builders have already reserved a total of 61 Titans — an average of 1.9 Titans per customer — and we anticipate delivering the first units to their owners in Mar/Apr 2027. More immediately, we now have three Titans at HQ going through final testing and calibration in preparation for our first "for-revenue" Titan prints this summer.

Business model
High-margin, SaaS-like recurring revenue from stacking cohorts of Titan owners purchasing ICON materials, software, and architecture as they build.
03
Objective Three ICON Prime · Government
DOW · 80% OF FY26 REVENUE

Installations
are weapons systems.

After six years of progressive R&D and pilot-scale projects with the military and the Army Corps of Engineers, the DOW has emerged as our largest customer this year — representing just over 80% of total 2026 revenue.

FIG. 02 · FORT BLISS, TX · 10 TRAINING BARRACKS · US ARMY
Delivered in 6 months at half the cost of the next best alternative — on time, on budget.

Our installations are weapons systems — just like our ships, tanks and planes.

Dale Marks · Asst. Secretary of Defense for Energy, Installations & Environment · Testimony before Congress, March 4, 2026

The military has the same problems with construction we see in the residential and commercial sectors: projects cost too much and take too long. The DOW also recognizes that substandard housing hurts troop readiness — positioning military infrastructure as active warfighting components and a means of maintaining readiness.

Our marquee project in 2026 is building 10 training barracks at Fort Bliss for the US Army in 6 months and at half the cost of their next best alternative. The project is on pace to complete on time and on budget, and we have absolutely delighted the Army with our performance.

Fort Bliss has already led to a $201M contract award at Fort Polk, with revenues to be recognized in 2027–2029, and now the floodgates are starting to open.

In Q1 2026 ICON earned $22.2M in revenue, representing 213% growth YoY and 99% growth QoQ. Revenue was 41% better than our original $15.7M plan, driven by Fort Bliss ramping faster than expected and some R&D contract milestone acceleration.

We are raising FY 2026 revenue guidance from $101M to a range of $103–$109M — roughly 4× growth over FY 2025 — supported by a strong contracted project backlog.

Series D · In flight
Capitalizing on the inflection point.
We ended Q1 2026 with $67.7M of cash in the bank and 259 headcount. While our financial plan gives us cash into Q1 2027, we feel compelled to fundraise now and capitalize on the inflection-point momentum of the business. We are running a focused Series D process with a strong list of potential investment partners.

07
Closing thoughts On my mind
NEXT 90 DAYS · TITAN MILESTONES

Overall it feels like we've hit the inflection point we've all been working toward for several years, and the team is as focused as we've ever felt it.

The primary area of risk right now is Titan product and technical development. Engineering is progressing, but we need to cross some key milestones in the next few months to be ready to print for revenue later in the summer. This is our biggest area of focus over the next 90 days.

In the rest of the organization, a meaningful part of our energy and focus is already beginning to shift into 2027. Business development teams are focused on the 2027 pipelines; product development and operations are preparing to deliver the first Titans to customers in early 2027; and we have begun a slow-rolling restructuring of the organization to reflect our three primary go-forward business units: Build, Tech, and Prime.

We plan to start sending quarterly investor updates through Carta within 45 days after the end of each quarter. In the meantime, please don't hesitate to reach out if you have questions.

Thank you for your continued support,

Jason Portnoy
President · ICON Technology, Inc.
